claim_review: Current model source pack and owner-confirmed numeric EU labels; visible construction only. No measured width grade, tested performance, fiber inference, guaranteed stock, free sample or fixed lead-time claims. Commercial answers use the approved original-style MOQ separately from custom proposals. Existing photos/SKUs and all unsubmitted fields preserved. Owner-approved per-model revision: four product/fit questions precede four ordering questions. No usual-EU-size fit guarantee. Product-specific distinctions reviewed against the previously sourced construction facts.
highlights:
Wide toe-box mesh walking sneakers with long curved teardrop-shaped side panels. Fine lines around the toe and a low sole profile give the upper a flowing casual appearance. Four color choices help buyers build a broader neutral assortment around one lace-up silhouette.
Black, Dark Grey, Light Grey, Khaki; EU 36-48 provide color and size choices for wholesale assortments.

faq.question: What are the available colors and sizes?
faq.answers: Black, Dark Grey, Light Grey, Khaki; EU 36-48. List the pair quantity for each color and EU size to request your assortment.

faq.question: What distinguishes the upper?
faq.answers: Long curved teardrop-shaped side panels, two narrow lines near the toe and a mesh low-top construction. Conventional laces adjust the upper.

faq.question: What closure does this low-top shoe use?
faq.answers: It uses conventional laces. The long curved teardrop side panels and two narrow toe lines form the upper design.

faq.question: How should I choose a size?
faq.answers: Request an EU sample size using your foot length and the socks you intend to wear. During the fitting, assess toe space, heel fit and the upper closure before choosing the bulk size assortment.

faq.question: What is the minimum order for the original style?
faq.answers: The original-style wholesale minimum is 2 pairs. Quantity pricing is shown on this page. Logo, material or custom packaging requests are quoted separately from the original-style order.

faq.question: How can I arrange a sample?
faq.answers: Request a sample quotation with your preferred color, EU size and delivery postcode. The quotation will include the sample charge, shipping cost and proposed dispatch schedule.

faq.question: What should I send for a branding or packaging quotation?
faq.answers: Send your logo artwork, preferred placement, packaging brief and order quantity. We can review the brief for this style and provide a proposal with the applicable minimum, cost and sample process.

faq.question: How can I get a delivered quotation and shipment schedule?
faq.answers: Send the color-size quantities and destination postcode or port, plus any packaging request. The quotation separates product cost from freight and sets out the dispatch plan and estimated transit time for your chosen shipping method.
